conclusion: Two reviewable revisions implemented and evaluated; neither demonstrates robust superiority over original and matched buy-and-hold. Negative results retained, not marketed as improvement.

limitations: No anonymous-contest predictive edge demonstrated; public contest outcomes already observed, diagnostic only.
Retrospective research, not a prospective trial. Vendor history not independently verified point-in-time.
Crypto assets are correlated; transfer holdouts share market regimes with previously observed BTC/ETH periods.
Exact-fill full-cash buyhold follows official convention but is not an implementable pre-sized fixed-quantity order; decision-sized passive control also provided.
Fixed quantity reserve cannot guarantee cash feasibility; rejected orders occur, including with original12% reserve.
Annual resets and continuous paths differ materially; neither may be cherry-picked.
No statistical-significance or general improvement claim.
